rich_summary: This section depicts Abhimanyu at the height of his ferocity within the Kaurava ranks. Single‑handedly, he devastates chariots, elephants, cavalry, and infantry, leaving the battlefield strewn with shattered vehicles and mutilated animals and warriors. His relentless assault terrifies the Kaurava army, causing many soldiers to panic and attempt to flee. Seeing the chaos, Duryodhana personally advances against him, prompting Drona and other great warriors—Karna, Kripa, Ashwatthaman, Shalya, and others—to surround Abhimanyu and protect the king. Even when encircled and struck by numerous arrows, Abhimanyu counters each attacker, slays the king of the Asmakas with astonishing precision, and wounds Karna with a powerful shaft. The episode underscores both Abhimanyu’s extraordinary prowess and the growing desperation of the Kaurava commanders facing a single, unstoppable young warrior.

highlight_spans.why: The opening imagery of shattered chariots and broken war gear establishes the scale of destruction caused by Abhimanyu.
The comparison of Abhimanyu to divine forces crushing vast hosts emphasizes the epic magnitude of his feat.
The moment where Kaurava soldiers abandon wounded relatives and flee captures the emotional collapse of the army.
Abhimanyu’s leonine roar and defiance while surrounded highlights his fearless heroism against overwhelming odds.
The shaft that pierces Karna’s armor and body is a dramatic turning point showing Abhimanyu’s lethal precision.

top_scenes.scene_text: Abhimanyu racing across the battlefield in his chariot, arrows flying as shattered chariots, fallen elephants, and slain warriors lie scattered around him.
A ring of legendary Kaurava warriors—Drona, Karna, Kripa, and others—surrounding the lone Abhimanyu as he roars like a lion and shoots down their arrows midair.
Abhimanyu releasing a blazing arrow that pierces through Karna’s armor, striking him so powerfully that the great warrior trembles like a mountain in an earthquake.
